name: University of Northampton

facts.text: The University of Northampton's Waterside Campus opened in September 2018 and is at University Drive, Northampton, NN1 5PH.
Northampton describes itself as one of the youngest universities in the UK and has won multiple awards for its social impact work.
Northampton's UCAS code is N38, and the international deposit for undergraduate and postgraduate taught courses is currently £7,000; once the deposit is paid the university can issue the CAS.
facts.sourceTitle: How to Apply as an International Student | UON

sources.title: How to Apply as an International Student | UON
sources.notes: Fetched. Page does not mention any pre-CAS, credibility or readiness interview, nor CAS Shield/Enroly. Quotes: 'Once you pay the deposit, we can issue you with a Certificate of Acceptance for Studies (CAS).' and 'Currently, the deposit for Undergraduate and Postgraduate taught courses is £7,000.' No official interview page found on northampton.ac.uk or askus.northampton.ac.uk in three searches.

sources.title: University of Northampton Pre-CAS process — Questions & AI Practice | UniMock
sources.notes: Competitor practice page naming Northampton's pre-CAS process; title only, no questions readable in snippet.

sources.title: University of Northampton: live CAS Shield tenant (northampton.cas-shield.com)
sources.notes: Probed 8 September 2026: the subdomain answers HTTP 200 with the Enroly CAS Shield sign-in page (random subdomains answer nothing), so the university runs its CAS process through Enroly. CAS Shield interviews follow the themes in Brunel's published policy; whether this university switches the interview on for every Nepali applicant is not stated here.
